column1: # Russian (ru). Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. Wave 3: the owner's direction is non-Latin only if easy, so this stays a proposal to report.

# percent_style has a no-break space (U+00A0) between the number and the sign, as Java's CLDR ru formatter prints it. decimal_style shows the grouping no-break space (U+00A0) and the decimal comma. font is system because Saira has no Cyrillic.
